items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Mr. Green was a delegate. He would come around there and, you know, you would record. He would come there, but if people didn't look right, he would stop it.

ctx.x: I heard they were notorious years ago, they would sit on each session.

Oh, oh, they had a delegate, Mr. Green. Mr. Green was a delegate. He would come around there and, you know, you would record. He would come there, but if people didn't look right, he would stop it. Stop the recording session. But no, he wasn't.
